name: recall
description: Spaced-repetition flashcards: study on the screen, and let the agent make cards from your notes and files, quiz you, explain misses and manage your decks. Imports Anki, CSV and Markdown.

screenshots.caption: Today: one button to study, your goal and your decks
Studying a card, with a keyboard shortcut for every answer
Cards: search, filter and fix everything you have written
Stats: activity, forecast and how much you remember
